diagnostic: For each named original archived dual-network vs Master3s2 game, pick the earliest maximizer of the opponent's actual normal own-bank deposits in ten joint steps. This retrospective window may use receipts; it does not select any live intervention. Report every deposited worker, original source of the settled cargo, -10/-5/-3 relative to window start, routes, physically reachable and unreachable opportunities.
holdout_scope: Both maps and officials have been seen. The second map previously served one-step freight prediction and unrelated tree response research. The new fork-denial label is withheld there. Its underlying 75/25 hybrid predates the new actor. Two maps, two actors, no independent strength claim.
forward: Scan both physical seats without opponent recorded order or future cash/trajectory/outcome. Only roots 219..289 (10..80 steps remaining), enemy collectors carrying >=60 and >=2<=d<=7 to own closest home. Enumerate all strictly decreasing shortest home paths of length min(3,d-1), bank excluded. Require at least two distinct first-step exits.
legal: Own collector must be strictly lighter. The replacement is a different single root command including NONE, cannot enter opposing base, self-recruit square or a teammate's actual simultaneous landing. Another hostile collector able to reach this landing with <= our cargo rules it out. Collision capture, not holding a planter in the way, is the physical mechanism.
coverage: For each enumerated enemy path, cover exists if the defender can collide at a pre-bank path position at move h=1,2,3 after its fixed first move, given at most h-1 further free moves. Score is mean among distinct first-exit groups of their covered-path fraction (equal exit group weights). Require >0 coverage in every group under the intervention, and total coverage increase >=0.25 vs archived friendly command. This is geometric reachability, not a prediction or promise of forcing several routes at once.
trigger: Frozen FreightPredictor.model.predict(public_observation, previous_up_to_5_same_seat_public_observations) for each rival worker at the root. Need p_deposit_10 >=0.40 AND expected_root_cash_10 >=40. Rank by expected_root_cash_10 * coverage gain, then highest minimum group coverage, then SHA256(seed|seat|turn|own_worker|target_worker|alternative). Take at most one root per map, no substitute map, no loosening or retrospective rescue of an empty map. Absent predictor ⇒ geometry diagnostics only.
live: One matched pair each available map. Root opponent acts as actually recorded simultaneously, both players generate every later action from their own observations. Original full Master3s2 code/temperature=1 and paired fresh RNG state. Validate real terminal scores by separate official full tape replay, compare opponent target own-bank receipts and whole-fleet economic contribution, real changes including negative/no-effect. One stream per root and time-budgeted opponent search limit attribution.

amendment_before_model_selection.at: Before scanning the frozen model on any game or generating branch outcomes; mechanical same-root ties shared with deployable policy
amendment_before_model_selection.tie: Use SHA256(freight-fork-v1|seat|turn|own_worker|target_worker|alternative) with map seed removed. The public policy never needs a map seed; map separation and all numeric criteria stay fixed.
